name: jv-ecommerce
description: 1. Clone reponsitory 2. copy the `.env` file, from `.env.template` and replace it keys 3. to create submodules use: ````cmd git submodule update --init --recursive ```` 4. run project ```cmd docker compose up --build ```

scripts.docker:rm:orderdb-order-items: docker exec -it order-db psql -U root -d order-db -c "DROP TABLE t_order_line_items;"
scripts.docker:rm:orderdb-orders: docker exec -it order-db psql -U root -d order-db -c "DROP TABLE t_orders;"
